verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents connecting your own repository, including multiple repositories, so coding agents can work with the codebase. It describes GitHub-backed delivery that honors branch rules and required reviews, and tracks each task's pull request in Review Hub for engineers to merge. missing for 10: detailed docs on the GitHub connection setup (app install, OAuth scopes, repo permissions), an explicit statement that the agent itself opens the PR, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Connect a starter app or your own repository.
Connect multiple repositories so coding agents can work with the broader codebase context
GitHub-backed delivery: branch rules, required reviews, GitHub Actions, and merge queues work out of the box.
Track each pull request in Review Hub, where engineers can check readiness and merge.
LightSprint tracks all PRs and manages ticket state
